title: Fundamentals of Statistics for Healthcare
description: The basics of statistical measurement and probability for health data: describing data, sampling, and a first look at inference. Practical sessions use Excel.
assessment: Computer-based written exam (90 minutes): multiple-choice/short questions, interpreting statistical output, and applied exercises on a dataset. A formula sheet and tables are provided.
textbooks: Rosner, B. (2016). Fundamentals of Biostatistics. Cengage.
Agresti, A. (2018). Statistical Methods for the Social Sciences (5th ed.). Pearson.
Plichta Kellar, S. B. & Kelvin, E. A. (2013). Munro's Statistical Methods for Health Care Research. Wolters Kluwer.
